
```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-scAS
#| tbl-cap: "Site Classification. Source: Australian Standard AS-1726"
#| tbl-label: "!expr(sprintf('fig-%s', as.character(as.numeric(Sys.time()))))"

SC=c("A","B","C","D","E")
Description=c(
  "Strong Rocks",#A,>1500 m/s
  "Rocks",#B,760 to 1500 m/s
  "Shallow soil site",#C 360 to 760 m/s
  "Deep or soft soil site", #D 180 to 360 m/s
  "Very soft soil site")#E 140-180 m/s
  

Vs30=c(
  ">1500 [m/s]",
  ">360 [m/s]",
  ">150 [m/s]",
  ">150 [m/s]",
  "<=150 [m/s]")

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  SC=SC,
  Description=Description,
  Vs30=Vs30)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(library="flextable",font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER)
TBL <- flextable::set_table_properties(TBL,layout = "autofit")

TBL
```
